title: World BEYOND War Europe Romania/Ireland chapter expansion

sources.title: World BEYOND War Europe Network Ireland letter

summary: Expanded the World BEYOND War seed into two current European chapter nodes and three explicit public coordinator/initiator people using current or recent first-party sources.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party chapter expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat current/recent first-party chapter statements as explicit local_chapter_of evidence.
Preserve Romania and Ireland as separate chapter organizations.
Treat Maria Cernat, Hans Hedrich, and Barry Sweeney roles as explicit public roles from first-party sources.
data.method: Follow the unresolved World BEYOND War Europe edge after Canada; enumerate current Romania and Ireland chapter surfaces and explicit chapter leadership roles.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current World BEYOND War European chapters and explicit public coordinator roles can be materialized from first-party sources in this bounded pass?

findings.finding: World BEYOND War's current Romania page identifies an active Romanian chapter and names Maria Cernat and Hans Hedrich in chapter leadership roles.
A June 5, 2026 World BEYOND War Europe Network article explicitly identifies Ireland for a World BEYOND War as the Ireland chapter.
World BEYOND War's #NoWar2025 page identifies Barry Sweeney as WBW Ireland Chapter Coordinator.
